name: Yuki
source:
A member of the Theatre Club, Yuki is energetic, friendly and positive, in direct contrast to most of its members. He openly shows his affection for Satsuki, though never laciviously. In spite of his child-like cheer, Yuki is surprisingly perceptive of everything that goes on around him. Since he works part time in the props department at the Stella Theatre during the day, he attends and studies at school in the evening. As a result, he can't attend the club as often as he'd like. He is self-conscious of his short height, and is quick to redeem himself as the physically strongest of the club. 

[Spoiler]Yuki suffered from memory loss, and was found by his current guardian. He later discovers that he is a partial entity of Misumi Kei, a scripwriter who is in a coma. Kei discovered that his master stole his script, and in despair, attempted to run away but fell off the stage. As a result of his injuries, he fell into a coma. Kei's anger and resentment gave birth to Yuki, but Yuki had no recollection of his "true" self.[/Spoiler]
